updates.title: Regent Centre Metro station early evening closures Monday-Thursday 7 September-29 October
updates.body: Regent Centre station will close at 9.00pm each evening Monday to Thursday on the dates listed below, to allow for station refurbishment work. When the station is closed trains will run through the station without stopping. Monday 7 September  – Thursday 10 September Monday 14 September – Thursday 17 September Monday 21 September – Thursday 24 September Monday 28 September – Thursday 1 October Monday 5 October – Thursday 8 October Monday 12 October – Thursday 15 October Monday 19 October – Thursday 22 October Monday 26 October – Thursday 29 October When the station is closed a replacement bus service 901 will be running between Regent Centre and South Gosforth in both directions. View the replacement bus timetable for Regent Centre to South Gosforth and South Gosforth to Regent Centre (7 September – 29 October) here View the replacement bus stop location maps for Regent Centre and South Gosforth (7 September-29 October) here If you wish to travel from Regent Centre towards the Airport when the station is closed, please travel to South Gosforth on the replacement bus service and continue your journey by Metro.  If you are travelling from the direction of the Airport and wish to leave the train at Regent Centre, please stay on the train until South Gosforth and travel back to Regent Centre on the replacement bus service. Metro tickets and passes will be valid on the replacement bus and the driver will sell tickets. If you are travelling using a Pop card and are starting your journey at Regent Centre show the replacement bus driver your Pop card (the Metro station will be closed so you will not be able to tap in), when you arrive at South Gosforth if you intend to travel further using Metro, remember to tap in on the station validator to begin your journey. If you plan to travel to Regent Centre on the replacement bus after travelling on Metro, remember to tap out at South Gosforth, before boarding the replacement bus service. Your journey will take longer so please leave extra travelling time. For the latest Metro service update view the live updates section or view the Pop App (available on Google Play and the App Store).

updates.body: The lift on platform 1 at Fellgate will be out of service from 10.00am on Friday 18 September until the start of service on Tuesday 22 September. If you require step free access and wish to travel from Fellgate platform 1, please travel from platform 2 to Pelaw, change platform and travel back towards Fellgate to continue your journey.  If you require step free access and want to travel to Fellgate platform 1, please stay on the train to Brockley Whins, change platform and travel back to Fellgate platform 2.  If using the alternative stations is not suitable for you please contact us on the station Help Point. updates.title: Night works
updates.body: To ensure our train service continues to run we need to carry out regular maintenance and improvement works on and around our tracks. Some work can be done during the day, but often work can only be completed safely when the train service is not running. This means we work overnight and during planned line closures. The type of work taking place includes inspections, patrolling the tracks, lineside management, maintenance and renewal work and cleaning. Sometimes the work generates noise which residents or businesses near to the Metro line may be able to hear. updates.title: Blakelaw bus diversions due to vandalism: Routes 6, 7, 32, 32A, X47, X77, X78, X87 and X88 – From Wednesday 16 September 2026 for approximately one month
updates.body: From 6:30pm on Wednesday 16 September 2026 and for a period of one month, Stagecoach North East advise that due to numerous acts of vandalism and antisocial behaviour in the Blakelaw area, Stagecoach services 6, 7, 32, 32A, X47, X77, X78, X87 and X88 will be required divert as follows: Service 32, 32A, X47, X77, X78, X87 and X88 buses will divert from Ponteland Road via Springfield Road, Stamfordham Road, the A1 Northbound, and Junction 77 (Kenton Bar) before rejoining their normal routes at Kenton Bar Roundabout. Services travelling towards Newcastle City Centre will follow the same diversion route in reverse. No service will operate between Springfield Road and Etal Lane in either direction from 1830 until the end of service. Service 6, and 7 buses will not observe Cragston Ave or Ponteland Road in either direction from 6:30pm until end of service. Buses will be diverted for a period of one month. This period will allow the situation to be monitored in partnership with Northumbria Police and local stakeholders, while providing an opportunity to assess whether conditions have improved sufficiently to allow the safe resumption of normal operations.

updates.title: Resurfacing works, A184, Gateshead – Disruption to Services 21, 27, 28B, 54, 56, 57, 58, 58A, 301, X1, X10, X12, X21, X72: Thursday 17 September 2026 – Thursday 24 September 2026
updates.body: From Thursday 17 September 2026, for seven consecutive nights between 8:00pm and 6:00am, resurfacing works on the A184 at the western entrance/exit of Gateshead Interchange will require bus service diversions. Most services will operate via the Swing Bridge in both directions. As a result, bus stops on Askew Road, Wellington Street, and St Nicholas Street (Newcastle High Level Bridge) will not be served. Additionally, Go North East Service 54 will be unable to serve Hawks Road and Gateshead Quays, Stagecoach Services X24 and X34 will be unable to serve Gateshead High Street. Customers travelling from the south side of the river are advised to use Gateshead Interchange. For services north of the river, please use bus stops in Newcastle City Centre before St Nicholas Street, including Newgate Street, Market Street, and Eldon Square.

updates.title: Thursday, 13 November 2025 – until further notice: Routes 10, 12, 50 and E1 – Closure of River Drive bridge (Heugh Street)
updates.body: Closure of River Drive bridge (Heugh Street) until further notice. So that structural inspection work can take place, the following alterations will continue to apply to services 10, 12, 50 and E1: Stagecoach Service 10 will operate via Keppel Street, Fowler Street, Winchester Street, Anderson Street, Coston Drive and Mile End Road, then run a one-way loop via Palatine Street, River Drive, Mile End Road and Coston Drive, before resuming the normal Service 10 route towards Jarrow. Stagecoach Services 12 and E1 will continue to operate via alternative routes. Customers are advised to use South Shields Interchange (12 and E1) or Ocean Road (E1 only). Go North East Sunday Service 50 is currently operating from South Shields Interchange to River Drive via Mile End Road. These arrangements apply until further notice. updates.title: Barrack Road Closures for Newcastle United home fixtures – Routes 12, 39, 40, 62, 63: August 2026 to May 2027
updates.body: On Newcastle United home match days, Barrack Road, between Gallowgate and Stanhope Street, will be closed in both directions from approximately 15 minutes prior to the scheduled finish of the match until up to 45 minutes after the actual final whistle . This is to allow for the safe dispersal of fans from St. James’ Park into the wider City Centre area. These closures will start with the friendly fixtures on Saturday 15 August (3:00pm kick off) and Sunday 16 August (4:00pm kick off) For full details of diversions for Services 12, 39, 40, 62 and 63 – please refer to Stagecoach North East website for full details . For example, for a 3:00pm kick off, the expected closure time would be between 4:30pm until approximately 5:30pm, and for a 7:45pm kick off, the expected closure time would be between 9:15pm and approximately 10:15pm. The exact closure times would be governed by event control and Northumbria Police on that day. These closures are also expected to be in place for other large events at St. James’ Park.
